message: You know those people who scoff at the idea of preparing for a storm? Well, I’ve got a little nugget of wisdom for them. There’s a whole world of tips out there to help keep us safe and comfortable, especially when the heat cranks up. It’s nice to have a plan, even if it does mean I get to say, "I told you so" when the next heatwave rolls in. Stay cool, everyone! ☀️
